findings.text: Per-console keyboard state combines two full bytes for lasting and sticky modifier locks with a single-bit LED control selector plus two four-bit fields for live and default LED flags plus a three-bit decoding selector plus a five-bit group of mode toggles.

Shift lock follows the shift group while altgr lock follows the altgr group and control lock follows the control group and alt lock follows the alt group with split left and right variants for shift and control, and LED display uses zero for traditional flag display while one selects ioctl-driven updates.

Scroll lock occupies position zero while numeric lock occupies one and caps lock occupies two and kana lock occupies three, and decoding uses zero for table translation while one selects medium raw and two selects raw scancodes and three selects unicode and four disables input, and mode positions assign zero to application keys while one selects cursor keys and two enables repeat and three selects carriage-return versus line-feed behaviour and four selects meta handling.

Flag helpers expose a single position from mode or LED storage as a zero-or-one result while companion setters force a position on and clearers force it off and togglers invert lasting locks plus sticky locks plus modes plus LED flags, and two extra helpers provide a folded transform of an input value and a Braille row base.

Build-time helpers emit assembler marker records that carry a name with a numeric value or an empty marker or a structure member displacement or a comment string, so layout facts can be recovered from build output without runtime effects.
Big-endian identity uses 4321 while little-endian identity uses 1234.

Configuration tests detect a defined option through placeholder expansion and second-argument selection, with paired helpers combining two results by conjunction and disjunction, and higher predicates distinguish built-in selection from module selection and from reachability that also requires module build context.

Core image descriptor links into a list and records a start address with a byte length and a category, where categories cover executable text plus dynamic mapping area plus physical memory plus direct-map metadata plus user memory in that declaration order.
List registration accepts a descriptor with address plus extent plus category but stores nothing and links nothing in the shown form, so callers observe no state change.

Coverage collection rests disabled before moving to initialized prior to any tracing choice, then selects either program-counter tracing into a per-task buffer or comparison-operand collection as alternative active modes.
Active switch bracketing forces a high indicator on before a task switch and clears it afterwards, while an alternate configuration defines both bracketing operations as empty.

Remote handle construction rejects subsystem or instance overflow against masks by returning zero and otherwise merges the two fields, while common and USB starters build a subsystem-tagged handle and delegate to a generic starter, and softirq-gated start and stop variants act only inside soft-interrupt service outside hard-interrupt context.

Compatibility fallbacks define generic remote start and stop plus task setup and teardown plus common handle retrieval plus common start plus USB start plus softirq-gated start and stop as empty operations that accept their declared arguments and produce no effect.
Switch indicator occupies bit thirty, while the coverage counter type selects a native word width in one configuration and a wider unsigned width in the other.
Access attributes assign bit zero to write while bit one marks compounded read-write and bit two marks atomicity and bit three marks assertion checks and bit four marks scoped coverage.

Active scoped descriptor holds either list linkage or a stack depth together with a target address plus an extent plus an attribute word plus a setup location, while an alternate configuration replaces the descriptor with an empty placeholder.

Sanitizer thread context groups a disable counter with a scoped-disable counter plus a countdown of upcoming atomic operations plus separate nestable depth and flat-region membership plus an access mask plus a list of live scoped descriptors plus an optional single reordering model descriptor.

Disabled-path helpers for access checking plus barrier notification plus thread disable and enable including a non-warning enable plus nestable and flat atomic bracketing plus atomic sequencing plus mask selection plus scoped termination accept their arguments without effect, while scoped initiation returns the caller-supplied descriptor and public check and toggle names alias the internal forms.

Barrier helpers select among compiler barrier plus signal fence with per-kind ordering strength versus aliasing to internal notifications versus empty expansion, while read plus write plus read-write adapters choose plain versus write versus compounded attributes, and exclusive writer plus exclusive access plus bit-masked assertions route through single checks or uniquely named scoped descriptors with automatic cleanup.
Fault report bundles register state with a message string plus a numeric error plus a trap number plus a signal number.
Minor field width is twenty bits while its mask covers exactly the low twenty bits.

Legacy validity bounds both components below 256 while system-V validity uses wider major and minor bounds, and legacy packing places major above minor in sixteen bits while extended packing spreads minor fragments around major with huge layouts reusing the extended rules and system-V packing places major above a wide minor with dedicated extractors, and decoding inverts each layout while formatting renders major and minor in decimal with a separator and one variant returns the supplied buffer.

Message prefixes pair a start byte of value one with digits zero through seven for emergency through debug plus a continuation marker and an empty default, while numeric priorities use minus two for deferred scheduling and minus one for default and zero through seven for emergency through debug.

Page flag positions use 32 for reserved while 33 marks locked and 34 marks second ownership and 35 marks private and 36 marks second private and 37 marks combined owner-private and 38 marks architecture and 40 marks soft-dirty and 41 marks second architecture and 42 marks third architecture.

Yield helpers select among conditional rescheduling versus static-call dispatch versus dynamic dispatch versus empty expansion, while sleep prohibition either records location or expands empty and sleep annotation either clears a task flag or expands empty and non-block bracketing either adjusts a per-task counter with underflow warning or expands empty, with low-level rescheduling and sleep checks empty in the shown form.
Sanitizer initialization accepts no arguments and performs no action in the shown form.

Several shown variants are intentionally empty and discard their inputs without linkage plus collection plus checking plus initialization effects, so callers must not assume side effects when those configurations are active.
